title: Phase 3: DevOps & Configuration
description:
Set up Docker, migrations, CI/CD, and tooling:
- .env.example (environment variable template)
- Dockerfile (multi-stage build with non-root user, healthcheck)
- docker-compose.yml (production: api + postgres)
- docker-compose.dev.yml (development with hot reload, volume mounts)
- .dockerignore (exclude unnecessary files from build)
- Makefile (dev, prod, down, logs, test, lint, format, migrate, migration, shell)
- alembic.ini (Alembic configuration)
- alembic/env.py (async migration support)
- alembic/script.py.mako (migration template)
- alembic/versions/.gitkeep
- pyproject.toml (ruff config, pytest config)
- .gitignore (Python, IDE, env, testing, database, logs)
- .pre-commit-config.yaml (ruff hooks)
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (GitHub Actions: lint + test on push/PR)

title: Phase 1: Core Foundation
description:
Set up project structure and core components:
- requirements.txt and requirements-dev.txt
- app/core/config.py (Settings, logging)
- app/db/session.py (async engine, session)
- app/db/base.py (DeclarativeBase)
- app/models/base.py (TimestampMixin, BaseModel)
- app/core/exceptions.py (HTTP exception classes)
- app/schemas/common.py (MessageResponse, PaginatedResponse, etc.)
- app/api/v1/health.py (health and readiness endpoints)
- app/api/v1/router.py (API router aggregation)
- app/main.py (FastAPI app with CORS, rate limiting, lifespan)
- All __init__.py files for packages
close_reason: All Phase 1 files created: requirements, core config/exceptions, db setup, models base, schemas common, health endpoints, router, main.py. Syntax verified.

title: Phase 2: Auth System
description:
Implement complete authentication system:
- app/models/user.py (User model with email, password hash, active/superuser flags)
- app/schemas/user.py (UserCreate, UserUpdate, UserResponse, UserInDB)
- app/schemas/auth.py (Token, TokenPayload, LoginRequest, RegisterRequest, RefreshRequest)
- app/core/security.py (password hashing, JWT creation/verification)
- app/services/base.py (generic CRUD BaseService)
- app/services/user_service.py (user-specific operations, authentication)
- app/api/deps.py (get_current_user, get_current_superuser dependencies)
- app/api/v1/auth.py (register, login, login/form, refresh, me endpoints)
- app/api/v1/users.py (list, get, update, delete user endpoints)

title: Phase 4: Testing
description:
Set up test infrastructure and write tests:
- tests/__init__.py
- tests/conftest.py (fixtures: event_loop, setup_database, db_session, client, test_user, auth_headers, superuser, superuser_headers)
- tests/test_health.py (health check, readiness check)
- tests/test_auth.py (register, login, refresh, me, validation, duplicates)
- tests/test_users.py (get, update, list, delete, permissions)

Uses SQLite for test database, httpx AsyncClient for API testing.

title: Phase 5: README & Verification
description:
Documentation and final verification:
- README.md (project overview, quick start, features table, structure, API endpoints, commands, customization guide, environment variables)

Final verification checklist:
- All files created per structure
- make dev starts successfully
- Health endpoints respond
- Auth flow works (register, login, refresh, me)
- Tests pass (make test)
- Linter passes (make lint)
- README is accurate

title: FastAPI Starter Template
description: Production-ready REST API template with authentication, async SQLAlchemy, Docker, and testing. Covers: Python 3.12+, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0 async, Pydantic v2, PostgreSQL, Docker/Compose, Alembic migrations, Pytest, Ruff linting.
